description: This file defines a static class 'CertificateLoader' responsible for loading and validating X509 certificates from a certificate store, specifically for TLS server and client authentication purposes. It includes methods for finding certificates by subject name, checking their key usage extensions, and managing certificate disposal.

classes.name: CertificateLoader
classes.description: A static utility class for loading and validating X509 certificates from a certificate store, tailored for TLS authentication scenarios.

methods.name: LoadFromStoreCert
methods.description: Loads a certificate from the specified store by subject name, with options to allow invalid certificates and specify server or client usage.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForServerAuth
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is permitted for server authentication based on its extended key usage.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForClientAuth
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is permitted for client authentication based on its extended key usage.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForKeyUsage
methods.description: Determines if a certificate's extended key usage includes a specific purpose OID, or defaults to allowed if no extension is present.

methods.name: DoesCertificateHaveAnAccessiblePrivateKey
methods.description: Checks if the certificate has an accessible private key.

methods.name: DisposeCertificates
methods.description: Disposes of all certificates in a collection except the specified one.
